en.t: Sergius III is elected pope, after coming out of retirement to take over the papacy from the deposed antipope Christopher
en.s: Pope Sergius III (c. 860 − 14 April 911) was the bishop of Rome and nominal ruler of the Papal States from 29 January 904 to his death. He was pope during a period of violence and disorder in central Italy, when warring aristocratic factions sought to use the material and military resources of the papacy.

zh.t: 塞尔吉乌斯三世当选教宗
zh.s: 塞尔吉乌斯三世于904年1月29日至911年去世期间担任罗马主教和教皇国名义上的统治者。他退出隐退状态，取代被废黜的对立教宗克里斯托弗，接掌教宗职位。其任内，意大利中部动荡不安，敌对贵族派系争相利用教廷的财力和军事力量。

en.s: On 29 January 1223, during a church service, the Sackalians attacked the Germans inside the stronghold of Viljandi. They killed Sword-Brothers, vartels, merchants and even Mauritius, the vogt of Viljandi. The rest of the Germans were put in stocks and shackles. Some men advanced on to the stronghold of Leole, were they told others to do the same. Subsequently, the same Sackalians took Hebbe, the vogt of Järvamaa, and brought him to Viljandi. The heart of a still-alive Hebbe was torn out of his chest, baked on fire and eaten ritually, in order to "become strong in the fight against the Christians".

zh.s: 1223年1月29日，萨卡拉人在礼拜期间袭击了维尔扬迪要塞内的德意志人。他们杀死宝剑骑士团成员、随从、商人，甚至杀死了维尔扬迪的行政官毛里修斯。其余德意志人被套上枷锁。一些人随后前往莱奥莱要塞，号召那里的人采取同样行动。此后，这批萨卡拉人抓住耶尔瓦地区行政官赫贝，将其带到维尔扬迪。他们在赫贝仍活着时剖出他的心脏，用火烤熟后按仪式分食，以求“在与基督徒作战时变得强大”。

en.s: On 29 January 1485, the siege of Vienna began during the war between Matthias Corvinus of Hungary and Emperor Frederick III. Vienna, in present-day Austria, fell in June.

zh.s: 1485年1月29日，匈牙利国王马加什·科尔维努斯与皇帝腓特烈三世交战期间，维也纳围城开始。今奥地利的维也纳于6月失守。

en.s: The Battle of the Scheldt also known as the Battle off Walcharen (known in Dutch as Slag bij Reimerswaal) was a naval battle that took place on 29 January 1574 during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The battle was fought between a Dutch rebel Sea Beggar fleet (which included English and Scottish troops) under Lodewijk van Boisot and a Spanish fleet under Julián Romero. The Spanish fleet was attempting to relieve the Spanish held town of Middelburg which was under siege but the fleet under Boisot intercepted them and were victorious with the destruction or capture of nearly fifteen ships.

zh.s: 斯海尔德河海战又称瓦尔赫伦岛外海海战，荷兰语称赖默斯瓦尔海战，发生于八十年战争和英西战争期间的1574年1月29日。交战双方为洛德韦克·范·布瓦索率领的荷兰起义军海上乞丐舰队，以及胡利安·罗梅罗指挥的西班牙舰队；荷兰舰队中还包括英格兰和苏格兰部队。西班牙舰队试图救援被围困的西班牙控制城镇米德尔堡，但被布瓦索拦截。荷兰舰队获胜，击毁或俘获近15艘敌舰。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Action of 29 January 1654 was a naval battle between small naval forces of the Dutch and the English, near either Bandar Abbas or Sindh.

zh.s: 1654年1月29日，荷兰和英国的小规模海军部队在班达阿巴斯或信德附近海域交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: On 29 January 1717, Austrian troops raided Veliko Gradište, in present-day Serbia, during the Austro-Turkish War. Ottoman forces ambushed them and inflicted heavy losses.

zh.t: 大格拉迪什泰战役爆发
zh.s: 1717年1月29日，奥军在奥土战争期间袭击今塞尔维亚的大格拉迪什泰，随后遭到奥斯曼军队伏击，损失惨重。

en.s: The capture of Fort-Dauphin was a bloodless encounter of the French Revolutionary Wars in which a Spanish expeditionary force under Admiral Gabriel de Aristizábal y Espinosa seized Fort-Dauphin (now Fort-Liberté), in Saint-Domingue, from France. The French garrison of about a thousand men, blockaded by land and sea, surrendered without firing a single shot.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 法军攻占海地堡垒达芬（1794年）
zh.s: 法国大革命战争期间，西班牙远征军在加布里埃尔·德·阿里斯蒂萨瓦尔·埃斯皮诺萨海军上将率领下，从法国手中夺取了圣多明各的堡垒达芬（今海地自由堡）。法国驻军约有1000人，陆海两面都遭封锁，最终不发一枪便投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Brienne was fought on 29 January 1814, and resulted in the victory of Emperor Napoleon I's French forces over the Russian and Prussian forces commanded by the Prussian Generalfeldmarschall Prince von Blücher. The battle followed on the heels of reverses suffered by the French in both 1812, which had gutted the strength of the French Army, and 1813, where they fought against the Sixth Coalition. The Sixth Coalition had intentions of deposing Napoleon, dissolving the First French Empire and restoring the Bourbon monarchy to France.

zh.s: 1814年1月29日，拿破仑一世率领的法军在布里耶讷战役中，击败普鲁士陆军元帅布吕歇尔亲王指挥的俄普联军。此前，法军在1812年遭受重创，实力大幅削弱，1813年又在对抗第六次反法同盟时接连受挫。第六次反法同盟的目标是推翻拿破仑、解散法兰西第一帝国，并恢复法国波旁王朝。

en.s: On 29 January 1827, the Battle of Kastella began near Piraeus, Greece, during the Greek War of Independence. The fighting continued into January 30.

zh.s: 1827年1月29日，希腊独立战争期间，卡斯特拉战役在比雷埃夫斯附近开始，战斗延续到1月30日。

en.s: On 29 January 1829, Greek and Ottoman forces fought at Martino, Greece, in one of the last battles of the Greek War of Independence.

zh.s: 1829年1月29日，希腊与奥斯曼军队在今希腊马尔蒂诺交战，这是希腊独立战争后期的战斗之一。

en.t: 1833 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1833 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 29 January 1833. This was the first Parliament after the Reform Act 1832. Not wishing to have an inexperienced Speaker preside over the reformed Parliament, the government persuaded the long-serving incumbent Speaker Charles Manners-Sutton to postpone his retirement. He was standing for a seventh term as Speaker.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1833年1月29日选举议长，这是1832年改革法案通过后的首届议会。政府不希望改革后的议会由一位缺乏经验的议长主持，因此说服长期担任议长的查尔斯·曼纳斯-萨顿推迟退休。他竞选第七个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Maqongqo was fought on 29 January 1840 during a civil war between Zulu factions. The Zulu king Dingane was challenged for the throne by his brother Mpande, in alliance with Boer settlers led by Andries Pretorius. Mpande and his supporters were victorious. Shortly thereafter Dingane was murdered and Mpande became king of the Zulus.

zh.s: 1840年1月29日，祖鲁各派内战期间发生马孔科战役。祖鲁国王丁冈的弟弟姆潘德，与安德里斯·比勒陀利乌斯率领的布尔移民结盟，争夺王位。姆潘德及其支持者获胜。不久之后，丁冈被杀，姆潘德成为祖鲁国王。

en.t: The Raven appears under Edgar Allan Poe’s name
en.s: On January 29, 1845, The Raven appeared in the New York Evening Mirror in the United States, attributed to Edgar Allan Poe. The poem brought him widespread attention.

zh.t: 《乌鸦》署名埃德加·爱伦·坡刊登
zh.s: 1845年1月29日，《乌鸦》在美国《纽约晚镜报》刊登，署名埃德加·爱伦·坡。这首诗为他带来广泛关注。

en.s: The Battle of Embudo Pass was part of the Taos Revolt, a popular insurrection against the American army's occupation of northern New Mexico. It took place on January 29, 1847, during the Mexican–American War, in what now is New Mexico.

zh.s: 1847年1月29日，墨西哥—美国战争期间，新墨西哥北部发生恩布多山口战役。这是陶斯起义的一部分；当时当地民众反抗美国军队占领该地区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 29 January 1848. Doroteo Vasconcelos ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. He was sworn in on 7 February 1848 and served until 1 February 1850. He ran again in the next election when a constitutional amendment was made to allow his reelection.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1848年1月29日举行总统选举。多罗特奥·巴斯孔塞洛斯在没有竞争对手的情况下由议会选为总统，于2月7日宣誓就职，任期至1850年2月1日。随后宪法经过修订，允许他连任，他也参加了下一次选举。

loc: 美国爱达荷州富兰克林县

en.s: The Bear River Massacre, or the Battle of Bear River or Massacre at Boa Ogoi, took place in present-day Idaho on January 29, 1863. After years of skirmishes and food raids on farms and ranches, the United States Army attacked a Shoshone encampment, gathered at the confluence of the Bear River and Beaver Creek in what was then southeastern Washington Territory. The site is located near the present-day city of Preston in Franklin County, Idaho. Colonel Patrick Edward Connor led a detachment of California Volunteers as part of the Bear River Expedition against Shoshone Chief Bear Hunter.

zh.s: 熊河大屠杀又称熊河战役或博阿奥戈伊大屠杀，发生于1863年1月29日，地点在今天美国爱达荷州境内。经过多年冲突及针对农场、牧场的抢粮袭击后，美军袭击了熊河与比弗溪汇合处的一座肖肖尼人营地。该地当时属于华盛顿领地东南部，位于今天爱达荷州富兰克林县普雷斯顿市附近。帕特里克·爱德华·康纳上校率一支加利福尼亚志愿军，作为熊河远征的一部分，进攻肖肖尼酋长“猎熊者”的部众。

en.s: On 29 January 1867, US troops commanded by George Crook attacked a Paiute village near Steen’s Mountain in Oregon, United States, during the Snake War.

zh.s: 1867年1月29日，斯内克战争期间，乔治·克鲁克指挥的美军袭击美国俄勒冈州斯廷斯山附近的一座派尤特族村落。

en.s: The 1875–1876 New Zealand general election was held between 20 December 1875 and 29 January 1876 to elect a total of 88 MPs in 73 electorates to the 6th session of the New Zealand Parliament. The Māori vote was held on 4 and 15 January 1876. A total of 56,471 voters were registered.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 新西兰于1875年12月20日至1876年1月29日举行大选，选出第六届议会的88名议员，来自73个选区。毛利人于1876年1月4日和15日投票。共有56,471名登记选民。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On January 29, 1889, Republican Francis B. Posey won the special election for Indiana’s 1st congressional district in the United States. He took his seat on February 6, filling the vacancy left by Alvin P. Hovey.

zh.t: 美国印第安纳州第一国会选区补选举行
zh.s: 1889年1月29日，共和党人弗朗西斯·B·波西赢得美国印第安纳州第一国会选区补选，填补阿尔文·P·霍维留下的空缺。他于2月6日就任。

en.s: Liliʻuokalani (Hawaiian pronunciation: [liˌliʔuokəˈlɐni]; Lydia Liliʻu Loloku Walania Kamakaʻeha; September 2, 1838 – November 11, 1917) was the only queen regnant and the last sovereign monarch of the Hawaiian Kingdom, ruling from January 29, 1891, until the overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom on January 17, 1893, in a coup that was led by the Committee of Safety, composed of seven foreign residents (five Americans, one Scotsman, and one German) and six Hawaiian Kingdom subjects of American descent in Honolulu.

zh.s: 莉莉乌欧卡拉尼（1838年9月2日—1917年11月11日）是夏威夷王国唯一一位女王，也是该王国最后一位君主。她于1891年1月29日即位，统治至1893年1月17日夏威夷王国在政变中被推翻。政变由“安全委员会”领导，该委员会成员包括七名外国居民（五名美国人、一名苏格兰人和一名德国人）以及六名具有美国血统的夏威夷王国臣民。

en.s: The Battle of Sandepu (also known as the Battle of Heikoutai) (Japanese: 黒溝台会戦 (Kokkōdai no kaisen), Russian: Сражение при Сандепу) was a major land battle of the Russo-Japanese War. It was fought within a group of villages about 36 miles (58 km) southwest of Mukden, Manchuria.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 沙河铺战役也称黑沟台战役，是日俄战争期间的一场重要陆战，发生在满洲奉天（今沈阳）西南约58公里的一组村庄内。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Magonista rebellion of 1911 was an early uprising of the Mexican Revolution organized by the Liberal Party of Mexico (Spanish: Partido Liberal Mexicano, PLM), which was only successful in northern Baja California. It is named after Ricardo Flores Magón, one of the leaders of the PLM. The Magonistas controlled Tijuana and Mexicali for about six months, beginning with the liberation of Mexicali on January 29, 1911.

zh.s: 1911年马贡主义者起义是墨西哥革命初期的一场起义，由墨西哥自由党组织，起义仅在下加利福尼亚北部取得成功。该运动以墨西哥自由党领袖之一里卡多·弗洛雷斯·马贡命名。起义者控制蒂华纳和墨西卡利约六个月，始于1911年1月29日解放墨西卡利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On 29 January 1911, Magonista rebels captured Mexicali in Baja California, Mexico, during the Mexican Revolution, meeting little resistance from government forces.

zh.t: 马贡派起义军攻占墨西卡利
zh.s: 1911年1月29日，墨西哥革命期间，马贡派起义军攻占下加利福尼亚的墨西卡利，政府军抵抗较弱。

en.s: The 1912–13 United States Senate elections were held on various dates in various states. They were the last U.S. Senate elections before the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment in 1913, establishing direct elections for all Senate seats. Senators had been primarily chosen by state legislatures. Senators were elected over a wide range of time throughout 1912 and 1913, and a seat may have been filled months late or remained vacant due to legislative deadlock.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1912年至1913年，美国各州在不同日期举行参议院选举。这是宪法第十七修正案获批准、确立所有参议员席位直接选举制度之前的最后一轮参议院选举。此前参议员主要由州议会选出，各州选举时间分散；若州议会陷入僵局，席位可能延迟数月才补齐，或暂时空缺。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 29 January 1916, the second round of the Drummoyne state by-election was held in New South Wales, Australia. The first round had taken place on January 22.

zh.t: 德拉莫因议会补选举行第二轮投票
zh.s: 1916年1月29日，澳大利亚新南威尔士州德拉莫因议会补选举行第二轮投票，首轮投票已于1月22日进行。

en.s: Kiev Arsenal January Uprising (Ukrainian: Січневе повстання Sichneve povstannya), sometimes called simply the January Uprising or the January Rebellion, was the Bolshevik organized workers' armed revolt that started on January 29, 1918 at the Kiev Arsenal factory during the Ukrainian-Soviet War. The goal of the uprising was to sabotage the ongoing elections to the Ukrainian Constituent Assembly and to support the advancing Red Army.

zh.s: 基辅兵工厂一月起义也简称一月起义或一月叛乱，是乌克兰—苏维埃战争期间，布尔什维克组织的一次工人武装起义，于1918年1月29日在基辅兵工厂爆发。起义旨在破坏正在进行的乌克兰制宪会议选举，并支援向基辅推进的红军。

en.s: The Battle of Ciucea from January 16–29, 1919 represented a military combat action of tactical level that opposed in the geographical area between the localities of Ciucea and Huedin located in Cluj county, Hungarian troops from the Romanian "Secuian Division".
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 丘恰战役是1919年1月16日至29日发生的一场战术级军事行动，交战双方是匈牙利军队与罗马尼亚“塞克勒师”，战场位于克卢日县丘恰和胡埃丁两地之间。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Portugal on 29 January 1922. The Democratic Party emerged as the largest in Parliament, winning 74 of the 163 seats in the House of Representatives and 37 of the 70 seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1922年1月29日举行大选。民主党成为议会第一大党，赢得众议院163席中的74席，以及参议院70席中的37席。

en.t: First Baseball Hall of Fame election tally completed
en.s: By January 29, 1936, the ballots for the first Baseball Hall of Fame election in the United States had been received and tallied. Ty Cobb, Babe Ruth, Honus Wagner, Christy Mathewson and Walter Johnson were elected. The result was publicly announced on February 2, the museum’s official election date.
en.n: January 29 records completion of the tally. The museum recognizes February 2, 1936, the public announcement, as the official election date.

zh.t: 棒球名人堂首届选举完成计票
zh.s: 截至1936年1月29日，美国棒球名人堂首届选举已收齐选票并完成统计，泰·科布、贝比·鲁斯、霍纳斯·瓦格纳、克里斯蒂·马修森和沃尔特·约翰逊当选。结果于2月2日公开，名人堂将这一天作为正式当选日期。
zh.n: 1月29日为计票完成日期；名人堂认定的正式当选日期为1936年2月2日，即结果公布之日。

en.s: The Bombing of La Garriga where a series of Nationalist air raids which took place at La Garriga, Barcelona province between the 28 and 29 January 1939 during the Spanish Civil War. At least 13 civilians were killed in the bombings.

zh.s: 1939年1月28日至29日，西班牙内战期间，国民军对巴塞罗那省拉加里加发动一连串空袭，造成至少13名平民死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Rennell Island (Japanese: レンネル島沖海戦) took place on 29–30 January 1943. It was the last major naval engagement between the United States Navy and the Imperial Japanese Navy during the Guadalcanal campaign of World War II. It occurred in the South Pacific between Rennell Island and Guadalcanal in the southern Solomon Islands. In the battle, Japanese naval land-based torpedo bombers, seeking to provide protection for the impending evacuation of Japanese forces from Guadalcanal, made several attacks over two days on US warships operating as a task force south of this island.

zh.s: 伦内尔岛海战发生于1943年1月29日至30日，是二战瓜达尔卡纳尔战役期间美国海军与日本帝国海军之间最后一次大规模海上交战。战场位于南太平洋所罗门群岛南部的伦内尔岛与瓜达尔卡纳尔岛之间。为掩护即将撤离瓜岛的日军，日本海军陆基鱼雷轰炸机在两天内多次袭击瓜岛以南执行任务的美国海军特遣舰队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Koniuchy (Kaniūkai) massacre was a massacre of civilians carried out by a Soviet partisan unit along with a contingent of Jewish partisans under their command during the Second World War in the Polish village of Koniuchy (now Kaniūkai, Lithuania) on January 29, 1944.

zh.s: 1944年1月29日，二战期间，一支苏联游击队及其指挥下的犹太游击队分队，在波兰科纽希村屠杀平民。该村今天名为卡纽凯，位于立陶宛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Air raid devastates Bologna’s anatomical theatre
en.s: On January 29, 1944, an air raid almost completely destroyed the Anatomical Theatre of the Archiginnasio in Bologna, Italy. It was later rebuilt using original pieces recovered from the rubble.

zh.t: 空袭重创博洛尼亚解剖剧场
zh.s: 1944年1月29日，一场空袭几乎摧毁意大利博洛尼亚阿奇吉纳西奥宫的解剖剧场。战后，剧场利用从废墟中找回的原构件重建。

en.s: On 29 January 1944, the battleship USS Missouri was launched at Brooklyn Navy Yard in New York, United States. Margaret Truman christened the ship. Its commissioning followed in June.

zh.s: 1944年1月29日，“密苏里”号战列舰在美国纽约布鲁克林海军造船厂下水，玛格丽特·杜鲁门为其主持命名仪式。该舰于同年6月正式服役。

en.s: Yeovil Town v Sunderland was a football match played on 29 January 1949 at the Huish Athletic Ground, Yeovil. The match was a tie in the Fourth Round of the FA Cup. Yeovil Town won the match 2–1, with Alec Stock and Eric Bryant scoring the goals for the winning side. The match is notable for being one of the few occasions in the history of the FA Cup where a non-league club has defeated a team in the top tier of English football.

zh.s: 1949年1月29日，约维尔与桑德兰在约维尔的休伊什运动场进行足总杯第四轮比赛。阿莱克·斯托克和埃里克·布赖恩特为约维尔进球，帮助球队以2比1获胜。这是足总杯历史上少数非职业联赛球队击败英格兰顶级联赛球队的比赛之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 29 January 1967. The result was a victory for the Liberal Democratic Party, which won 277 of the 486 seats. Voter turnout was 73.99%.

zh.s: 日本于1967年1月29日举行大选。自由民主党获胜，赢得486个议席中的277席。投票率为73.99%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: EgyptAir Flight 741 was a flight between Cairo International Airport and the now-defunct Nicosia International Airport that crashed on 29 January 1973. All 37 people on board died. The plane crashed in the Kyrenia mountain range in Cyprus on its descent while approaching the runway from the north. The resulting explosion, about 12 miles (19 km) from Nicosia airport, resulted in a fire which was put out by the Cypriot National Guard.

zh.s: 埃及航空741号班机往返于开罗国际机场与如今已停用的尼科西亚国际机场之间，于1973年1月29日坠毁，机上37人全部遇难。飞机从北侧接近跑道、下降进场时，在塞浦路斯凯里尼亚山脉坠毁。坠机地点距尼科西亚机场约12英里（19公里），爆炸引发的大火由塞浦路斯国民警卫队扑灭。

en.s: The First Battle of Amgala was fought between 27 and 29 January 1976 around the oasis of Amgala, Western Sahara, about 260 kilometres (160 mi) west of the border with Algeria. Units from the Algerian Army were attacked by units from the Royal Moroccan Armed Forces on the night of 27 January. The Algerians withdrew after fighting for 36 hours.

zh.s: 1976年1月27日至29日，第一次阿姆加拉战役发生在西撒哈拉阿姆加拉绿洲附近，该地位于阿尔及利亚边界以西约260公里（160英里）。1月27日夜间，摩洛哥皇家武装部队袭击当地的阿尔及利亚军队。经过36小时交战，阿尔及利亚军队撤退。

en.t: Libyan-backed offensive begins in northern Chad
en.s: On 29 January 1978, Goukouni Oueddei’s forces launched the Ibrahim Abatcha offensive against government outposts in northern Chad, with the active participation of Libyan ground troops.

zh.t: 利比亚支持的攻势在乍得北部展开
zh.s: 1978年1月29日，古库尼·韦戴的部队在利比亚地面部队直接参与下，向乍得北部的政府据点发动“易卜拉欣·阿巴查”攻势。

en.s: At about 6 p.m. on 29 January 1983, the derrick of the Eniwetok, a Panamanian-registered oil rig, passed under the aerial ropeway of the Singapore Cable Car system and struck the cable that stretched over the waterway between the Jardine Steps Station and the Sentosa Station. As a result, two cabins plunged 55 metres (180 ft) into the sea, killing seven people.

zh.s: 1983年1月29日18时左右，一座巴拿马注册的石油钻井平台“埃尼威托克”号从新加坡缆车线路下方经过，撞上了横跨贾丁阶梯站与圣淘沙站之间水道的缆索。两节缆车车厢因此坠入55米（180英尺）深的海中，造成7人死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in Ecuador on 29 January 1984, with a second round of the presidential elections on 6 May. After finishing second in the first round, León Febres Cordero of the Social Christian Party won the run-off with 51.5% of the vote. The Democratic Left emerged as the largest faction in the House of Representatives, winning 24 of the 69 seats.

zh.s: 厄瓜多尔于1984年1月29日举行大选，总统选举第二轮投票于5月6日举行。社会基督教党的莱昂·费夫雷斯·科尔德罗在首轮排名第二，但以51.5%的得票率赢得第二轮投票。民主左翼党成为众议院第一大党，赢得69席中的24席。

en.s: The 5th Yokohama Film Festival (第5回ヨコハマ映画祭) was held on 29 January 1984 in Kanagawa Prefectural Youth Centre Hall, Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan.

zh.s: 第5届横滨电影节于1984年1月29日在日本神奈川县横滨市的神奈川县立青少年中心礼堂举行。

en.s: The 1989 West Berlin state election was held on 29 January 1989 to elect the members of the 11th Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin. This was the last election held in West Berlin before the reunification of Germany and Berlin. The CDU suffered a severe defeat under its top candidate, the Governing Mayor Eberhard Diepgen, who had been in office since 1984.

zh.s: 西柏林于1989年1月29日举行州选举，选出第11届柏林众议院议员。这是德国统一前西柏林举行的最后一次选举。基民盟在州长埃伯哈德·迪普根领导下遭遇惨败；他自1984年起担任州长。

en.s: The Battle of Khafji was the first major ground engagement of the Gulf War. It took place in and around the Saudi Arabian city of Khafji, from 29 January to 1 February 1991. Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, who had already tried and failed to draw Coalition forces into costly ground engagements by shelling Saudi Arabian positions and oil storage tanks and firing Scud surface-to-surface missiles at Israel, ordered the invasion of Saudi Arabia from southern Kuwait.
en.n: Gulf War: The Battle of Khafji, the first major ground engagement of the war, as well as its deadliest, begins between Iraq and Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 海湾战争期间，伊拉克与沙特阿拉伯军队于1991年1月29日至2月1日在沙特城市哈夫吉及周边地区交战。这是海湾战争中的首场大型地面战，也是伤亡最惨重的一场。伊拉克领导人萨达姆·侯赛因此前曾试图通过炮击沙特阵地和储油设施、向以色列发射飞毛腿地对地导弹，引诱联军打一场代价高昂的地面战；均未成功后，他下令从科威特南部入侵沙特阿拉伯。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的日期。

en.t: US Marines retake Umm al Maradim
en.s: On 29 January 1991, US Marines assaulted and recaptured Umm al Maradim, an island off Kuwait, during the Gulf War. They destroyed Iraqi weapons stored there and raised the Kuwaiti flag.

zh.t: 美军收复乌姆马拉迪姆岛
zh.s: 1991年1月29日，海湾战争期间，美国海军陆战队登陆并收复科威特外海的乌姆马拉迪姆岛，摧毁伊军存放的武器，并升起科威特国旗。

en.s: A by-election for the Australian House of Representatives division of Werriwa was held on 29 January 1994. It was triggered by the resignation of sitting Labor Party member and former minister John Kerin. The by-election was won by Labor Party candidate Mark Latham, retaining the seat for his party. The by-election was marked by a swing against the ALP of almost twelve per cent.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院韦里瓦选区于1994年1月29日举行补选。时任工党议员、前部长约翰·克林辞职后，该席位出缺。工党候选人马克·莱瑟姆赢得补选，为该党保住席位。工党得票率下降了近12个百分点。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 29 January 1995 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities.

zh.s: 列支敦士登于1995年1月29日举行地方选举，选出全国11个市镇的议会和市镇长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: Chirac announces an end to French nuclear testing
en.s: On 29 January 1996, French President Jacques Chirac announced in a broadcast from Paris, France, that France was ending its nuclear tests permanently.

zh.t: 希拉克宣布法国永久停止核试验
zh.s: 1996年1月29日，法国总统雅克·希拉克在巴黎发表广播电视讲话，宣布法国永久停止核试验。

en.s: Europe XI v Africa XI (1997) was a friendly football match that took place on January 29, 1997 at the Estádio da Luz in Lisbon, Portugal, between a European select side and an African select side. The match was jointly organized by UEFA and CAF as part of the European Year against Racism. The African XI won 2–1 with goals from Abedi Pele and Mustapha Hadji.

zh.t: 1997年欧洲明星队对非洲明星队
zh.s: 1997年1月29日，欧洲明星队与非洲明星队在葡萄牙里斯本光明球场进行一场足球友谊赛。比赛由欧足联和非洲足联共同主办，是欧洲反种族主义年活动的一部分。阿贝迪·贝利和穆斯塔法·哈吉为非洲队进球，帮助球队以2比1获胜。

en.s: Local government elections were held in Sri Lanka on 29 January 1998 for 17 local authorities on the Jaffna Peninsula, in the north of the country. They were the first local elections held in the peninsula since 1983. Turnout was low due to the threats issued by the rebel Tamil Tigers.

zh.s: 1998年1月29日，斯里兰卡为北部贾夫纳半岛17个地方政府举行选举。这是该半岛自1983年以来首次举行地方选举。由于叛乱组织泰米尔猛虎组织发出威胁，投票率较低。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: House of Assembly elections were held in Tobago on 29 January 2001 to elect the twelve members of the Tobago House of Assembly. The Tobago Council of the People's National Movement won eight seats with 46.73% of the vote, while the governing National Alliance for Reconstruction won four seats with 38.44% of the vote. This election is the only time to date that the United National Congress participated in an election in Tobago.

zh.s: 多巴哥于2001年1月29日举行选举，选出多巴哥众议院的12名议员。人民民族运动多巴哥委员会获得8席、得票率46.73%；执政的重建全国联盟获得4席、得票率38.44%。这是迄今为止联合民族大会唯一一次参加多巴哥选举。

en.t: Bush uses “axis of evil” in his State of the Union address
en.s: On January 29, 2002, US President George W. Bush delivered the State of the Union address at the US Capitol in Washington, D.C., United States. He used the phrase “axis of evil” after discussing North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

zh.t: 布什在国情咨文中使用“邪恶轴心”一词
zh.s: 2002年1月29日，美国总统乔治·W·布什在华盛顿国会大厦发表国情咨文，谈及朝鲜、伊朗和伊拉克后，使用了“邪恶轴心”一词。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Finland on 15 and 29 January 2006 which resulted in the re-election of Tarja Halonen as President of Finland for a second six-year term. The first round of voting in Finnish presidential elections always takes place on the third Sunday of January, in this case 15 January 2006. As no candidate received more than half of the vote, a second round was held on 29 January between the two highest placed candidates from the first round, Tarja Halonen and Sauli Niinistö. Tarja Halonen, the incumbent, won the final round by 3.6 percentage points.

zh.s: 芬兰于2006年1月15日和29日举行总统选举，塔里娅·哈洛宁成功连任，获得第二个六年任期。芬兰总统选举首轮投票惯例安排在1月第三个星期日，当年为1月15日。由于无人获得过半选票，首轮得票最多的哈洛宁和绍利·尼尼斯托于1月29日进入第二轮。现任总统哈洛宁最终以领先3.6个百分点的优势获胜。

en.s: Royal Rumble (2006) was the nineteenth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was presented by Sony Computer Entertainment's The Con. It took place on January 29, 2006, in the American Airlines Arena in Miami, Florida and featured talent from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. As has been customary since 1993, the Royal Rumble match winner received a match at that year's WrestleMania, (in this instance: WrestleMania 22) for his choice at either the WWE Championship or the World Heavyweight Championship. Six professional wrestling matches were featured on the event's supercard, a scheduling of more than one main event.

zh.s: 2006年皇家大战是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）举办的第19届年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，由索尼电脑娱乐游戏《The Con》冠名。比赛于1月29日在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密美航球馆举行，参赛选手来自Raw和SmackDown!品牌。按照自1993年以来的惯例，皇家大战淘汰赛胜者可在当年的摔角狂热大赛中挑战一项冠军。本届胜者可在第22届摔角狂热大赛中，选择挑战WWE冠军或世界重量级冠军。本场赛事共六场比赛，安排了不止一场重点对决。

en.s: The retained source dates the Battle of Najaf, Iraq, to 28–29 January 2007. Iraqi security forces, supported by foreign troops, fought near Zarqa outside Najaf.
en.n: January 29 follows the retained range endpoint; the narrative dates the main fighting to January 28.

zh.s: 来源将伊拉克纳杰夫战役记为2007年1月28日至29日。伊拉克安全部队在外国部队支援下，于纳杰夫郊外扎尔卡附近作战。
zh.n: 1月29日采用来源所列的结束日期；正文将主要战斗记为1月28日。

en.s: The 2008 Florida Democratic presidential primary took place on January 29, 2008. Originally, the state had 185 delegates up for grabs that were to be awarded in the following way: 121 delegates were to be awarded based on the winner in each of Florida's 25 congressional districts while an additional 64 delegates were to be awarded to the statewide winner.

zh.t: 2008年佛罗里达州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年佛罗里达州民主党总统初选于1月29日举行。该州最初设有185个待分配的代表名额：121个根据全州25个国会选区各自的选举结果分配，另64个根据全州获胜者分配。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2008 Florida Republican presidential primary was held on January 29, 2008, with 57 delegates at stake on a winner-take-all basis. The Republican National Committee removed half of Florida's delegates because the state committee moved its Republican primary before February 5. Arizona Senator and eventual nominee John McCain won the primary with 36% of the vote. As a presidential candidate, former New York City mayor Rudy Giuliani concentrated heavily on the Florida primary.

zh.t: 2008年佛罗里达州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年佛罗里达州共和党总统初选于1月29日举行，57个代表名额采用胜者全得方式分配。由于该州共和党委员会将初选提前到2月5日之前，共和党全国委员会削减了该州一半的代表名额。亚利桑那州参议员约翰·麦凯恩以36%的得票率获胜，并最终成为共和党总统候选人。另一名参选者、纽约市前市长鲁迪·朱利安尼则曾把大量竞选精力集中在佛罗里达州初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2008 Orlando mayoral election took place on January 29, 2008. Incumbent Mayor Buddy Dyer ran for re-election to a second full term. Dyer was challenged by businessman Ken Mulvaney, his main opponent in the 2004 election. Mulvaney challenged his loss in the election, alleging that Dyer illegally paid a consultant to collect absentee ballots, which culminated in Dyer's indictment and suspension from office, and a special election.

zh.s: 2008年奥兰多市长选举于1月29日举行。现任市长巴迪·戴尔争取第二个完整任期，对手是商人肯·马尔瓦尼，后者也是他在2004年选举中的主要竞争对手。马尔瓦尼此前不服败选，指控戴尔非法付费给一名顾问收集缺席选票。这场争议最终导致戴尔被起诉并停职，随后举行特别选举。

en.s: The 2011 AFC Asian Cup final was a football match that took place on 29 January 2011 at the Khalifa International Stadium in Al Rayyan, Qatar, to determine the winner of the 2011 AFC Asian Cup. The match was won by Japan, defeating Australia 1–0 after extra time through a goal scored by Tadanari Lee. Japan thus qualified for the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup as the representative from AFC.

zh.s: 2011年亚洲杯决赛于1月29日在卡塔尔赖扬的哈利法国际体育场举行。凭借李忠成在加时赛中的进球，日本队以1比0击败澳大利亚夺冠，并因此获得代表亚足联参加2013年国际足联联合会杯的资格。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Strikeforce: Diaz vs. Cyborg was a mixed martial arts event that was held by Strikeforce on January 29, 2011 at the HP Pavilion in San Jose, California, United States.

zh.s: “Strikeforce：迪亚兹对机械战警”是Strikeforce于2011年1月29日在美国加利福尼亚州圣何塞惠普馆举办的综合格斗赛事。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: 2011 CAF Super Cup played in Lubumbashi
en.s: On 29 January 2011, TP Mazembe and FUS Rabat played the CAF Super Cup in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo. After a 0–0 draw, TP Mazembe won the penalty shootout 9–8.

zh.t: 2011年非洲超级杯在卢本巴希举行
zh.s: 2011年1月29日，马泽姆贝与拉巴特联盟在刚果（金）卢本巴希争夺非洲超级杯。双方0比0战平后，马泽姆贝在点球大战中以9比8获胜。

en.s: On January 29, 2011, KSW Extra 2 took place at Hala MOSiR in Ełk, Poland.

zh.s: 2011年1月29日，KSW Extra第2期综合格斗赛在波兰埃乌克的Hala MOSiR体育馆举行。

en.s: Royal Rumble (2012) was the twenty-fifth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on January 29, 2012 at the Scottrade Center in St. Louis, Missouri. It has been customary since 1993, the Royal Rumble match winner received a match at that year's WrestleMania (in this instance: WrestleMania XXVIII) for his choice at either the WWE Championship or the World Heavyweight Championship. Six professional wrestling matches were featured at the event. The main event was the annual 30-competitor Royal Rumble. Sheamus, the twenty-second entrant, won the match by last eliminating Chris Jericho, the twenty-ninth entrant.

zh.s: 2012年皇家大战是WWE举办的第25届年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1月29日在美国密苏里州圣路易斯史考特证券中心举行。按照自1993年以来的惯例，皇家大战淘汰赛胜者可在当年的摔角狂热大赛中挑战一项冠军。本届胜者可在第28届摔角狂热大赛中，选择挑战WWE冠军或世界重量级冠军。赛事共有六场比赛，主赛是年度30人皇家大战淘汰赛。第22个出场的希莫斯最后淘汰第29个出场的克里斯·杰里科，赢得比赛。

en.s: Elections to the Royal Cambodian Senate were held on 29 January 2012, with all 57 seats in the Senate being contested. The result was a victory for the ruling Cambodian People's Party, which won 46 of the 57 seats. The Sam Rainsy Party gain a net of eleven seats, ending with a total of 11 seats. The royalist FUNCINPEC lost all of its nine seats.

zh.s: 柬埔寨于2012年1月29日举行参议院选举，争夺全部57个参选席位。执政的柬埔寨人民党获胜，赢得46席。桑兰西党净增11席，共获11席。保王派奉辛比克党失去了原有的全部九席。

en.s: The 2012 Maine Republican presidential caucuses were held between Sunday, January 29, and Saturday, March 3, at various locations throughout the state of Maine. Presidential preference polls (straw polls) were held at the caucuses, but those polls were not binding on the choices of delegates to the Maine Republican Party convention. The caucuses chose delegates in processes separate from the straw polling.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2012年缅因州共和党总统候选人党团会议
zh.s: 缅因州共和党总统候选人党团会议于2012年1月29日至3月3日在该州多个地点举行。会议进行总统候选人意向民调，但民调结果不会约束缅因州共和党代表大会的代表人选；党团会议另行选出代表。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 2013 Tamarua by-election was a by-election in the Cook Islands electorate of Tamarua. It was held on 29 January 2013, and was precipitated by the death of sitting MP Pukeiti Pukeiti. The by-election was won by the Democratic Party's Tetangi Matapo.

zh.s: 库克群岛塔马鲁阿选区于2013年1月29日举行补选。补选因现任议员普凯蒂·普凯蒂去世而举行，民主党候选人特唐吉·马塔波获胜。

en.s: SCAT Airlines Flight 760 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Kokshetau to Almaty, Kazakhstan, operated by a Bombardier CRJ200 twinjet that on 29 January 2013 crashed in thick fog near the village of Kyzyltu, while on approach to Almaty. All 16 passengers and 5 crew on board were killed. The subsequent investigation determined that the aircraft had descended abruptly after pitching nose-down, but was unable to establish the cause of the sudden manoeuvre.

zh.s: SCAT航空760号班机是一趟从哈萨克斯坦科克舍套飞往阿拉木图的定期国内客运航班，由注册号为HC-BLF的庞巴迪CRJ200双发客机执飞。2013年1月29日，飞机在浓雾中进近阿拉木图时，于克孜勒图村附近坠毁。机上16名乘客和5名机组人员全部遇难。后续调查认定飞机机头突然下俯后急剧下降，但无法确定这一突发动作的原因。

en.s: On 29 January 2015, militants from the ISIL-affiliated Wilayat Sinai (Sinai Province) militant group launched a series of attacks on army and police bases in Arish using car bombs and mortars. The attacks, which occurred in more than six different locations, resulted in 44 deaths.

zh.s: 2015年1月29日，与伊斯兰国有关联的西奈省武装分子使用汽车炸弹和迫击炮，袭击阿里什的军警基地。这一系列袭击发生在六个以上地点，共造成44人死亡。

en.s: Operation Diablo Express was a cross-border raid launched on 29 January 2016, by a combined force of Mexican and American police to apprehend members of the Sinaloa Cartel in Lukeville, Arizona, and the neighboring border town Sonoyta, in the northwestern Sonora. According to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) spokeswoman Gillian M. Christensen; the Sinaloa cartel "cell" targeted in Sonoyta and the adjacent Lukeville area were responsible for the "importation of millions of pounds of illegal drugs, including marijuana, heroin, cocaine and methamphetamine" into the United States, as well as the smuggling of "millions of dollars in U.S. currency, along with weapons, into Mexico."

zh.s: 2016年1月29日，墨西哥和美国警方联合展开“恶魔快车”跨境突袭行动，在美国亚利桑那州卢克维尔及相邻的墨西哥索诺拉州西北部边境城镇索诺伊塔，抓捕锡那罗亚贩毒集团成员。美国移民与海关执法局发言人吉莉安·M.克里斯滕森称，此次针对的集团分支负责向美国输入数百万磅大麻、海洛因、可卡因和甲基苯丙胺等非法毒品，并将数百万美元现金及武器走私进入墨西哥。

en.s: On January 29, 2016, Bellator 148: Daley vs. Uhrich took place at the Save Mart Center in Fresno, California, United States. It aired live on Spike TV.

zh.s: 2016年1月29日，Bellator第148期“戴利对乌里奇”综合格斗赛在美国加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺的Save Mart Center举行，由Spike TV直播。

en.s: The 2017 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 30th annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 29, 2017, at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas.

en.s: The French Socialist Party held a two-round presidential primary to select a candidate for the 2017 presidential election on 22 and 29 January 2017. It was the second open primary (primaires citoyennes) held by the centre-left coalition, after the primary in 2011 in which François Hollande defeated Martine Aubry to become the Socialist nominee. Hollande went on to defeat incumbent Nicolas Sarkozy in the 2012 presidential election.

zh.t: 2017年法国社会党总统候选人初选
zh.s: 法国社会党于2017年1月22日和29日举行两轮总统候选人初选，为当年的总统选举确定候选人。这是中左翼联盟第二次举行向公众开放的“公民初选”。首次是在2011年，弗朗索瓦·奥朗德击败马蒂娜·奥布里，成为社会党候选人，随后又在2012年总统选举中击败时任总统尼古拉·萨科齐。

en.s: The Raid on Yakla was a joint United States/United Arab Emirates military operation carried out on January 29, 2017 in al-Ghayil, a village in the Yakla area of the Al Bayda Governorate of central Yemen, during the Yemeni civil war. Prepared by U.S. counterterrorism officials under President Barack Obama, the mission was ultimately authorized by President Donald Trump nine days into his presidency.

zh.s: 2017年1月29日，也门内战期间，美国与阿拉伯联合酋长国在也门中部贝达省亚克拉地区的盖伊勒村联合展开军事突袭。行动由贝拉克·奥巴马任内的美国反恐官员筹备，最终由上任仅九天的总统唐纳德·特朗普批准。

en.s: On the evening of January 29, 2017, an Islamophobic domestic terrorist attack took place at the Islamic Cultural Centre of Quebec City, a mosque in the Sainte-Foy neighbourhood of Quebec City, Canada. Six worshippers were killed and five others seriously injured after evening prayers when the gunman entered the prayer hall shortly before 8:00 pm and opened fire for about two minutes with a semi-automatic pistol.

zh.t: 魁北克市清真寺枪击案
zh.s: 2017年1月29日晚，加拿大魁北克市圣福瓦区的魁北克伊斯兰文化中心清真寺，发生一起仇视伊斯兰教的本土恐怖袭击。晚间祈祷结束后，一名枪手在晚上8时前不久进入礼拜大厅，用半自动手枪开火约两分钟，造成六名礼拜者死亡、五人重伤。

en.s: The 2017 Taça da Liga final was the final match of the 2016–17 Taça da Liga, the tenth season of the Taça da Liga. It was played on 29 January 2017 at Estádio Algarve. The competition involved the 35 clubs playing in the top two tiers of the Portuguese football league system – 18 from Primeira Liga and 17 from Segunda Liga – during the 2016–17 season.

zh.s: 2017年葡萄牙联赛杯决赛是2016—2017赛季葡萄牙联赛杯的决赛，也是该赛事第10届比赛的收官战。比赛于2017年1月29日在阿尔加维体育场举行。该赛季共有35支葡萄牙足球联赛前两级球队参赛，其中葡超18队、葡甲17队。

en.t: Qatar v United Arab Emirates (2019 AFC Asian Cup)
en.s: An AFC Asian Cup match between Qatar and the United Arab Emirates occurred on 29 January 2019, as part of the 2019 AFC Asian Cup. It was held at the Mohammed bin Zayed Stadium in the capital of the United Arab Emirates, Abu Dhabi. The match is referred as the Blockade Derby, due to the then-ongoing Qatar diplomatic crisis and deterioration of Qatar–United Arab Emirates relations.

zh.t: 卡塔尔对阵阿联酋（2019年亚洲杯）
zh.s: 2019年1月29日，卡塔尔与阿联酋在2019年亚洲杯比赛中交手，比赛在阿联酋首都阿布扎比的穆罕默德·本·扎耶德体育场举行。由于当时卡塔尔外交危机持续，卡塔尔与阿联酋关系恶化，这场比赛也被称为“封锁德比”。

en.s: The 2022 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 35th annual Royal Rumble and took place on January 29, 2022, at The Dome at America's Center in St. Louis, Missouri. The event was the first Royal Rumble to livestream on Peacock.

zh.s: 2022年皇家大战是WWE举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛选手来自其主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是第35届皇家大战，于2022年1月29日在美国密苏里州圣路易斯美国中心穹顶体育馆举行，也是首届通过Peacock平台直播的皇家大战。

en.s: The 2022 Italian presidential election was held in Rome between 24 and 29 January 2022. The president of Italy was elected by a joint assembly composed of the Italian Parliament and regional representatives. The election process extended over multiple days, culminating in incumbent president Sergio Mattarella being confirmed for a second term, with a total of 759 votes on the eighth ballot.

zh.s: 意大利于2022年1月24日至29日在罗马举行总统选举。总统由意大利议会两院议员和各大区代表组成的联席会议选出。选举历时数日，最终现任总统塞尔焦·马塔雷拉在第八轮投票中获得759票，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The Green Party (SZ) leadership election of 2022 was held on 29 January 2022. The incumbents Magdalena Davis and Michal Berg were elected for another term.

The competition involved the 34 clubs playing in the top two tiers of the Portuguese football league system – 18 from Primeira Liga and 16 from Liga Portugal 2 – during the 2021–22 season.

zh.s: 2022年葡萄牙联赛杯决赛是2021—2022赛季葡萄牙联赛杯的决赛，也是该赛事第15届比赛的收官战。比赛于2022年1月29日在莱里亚市政体育场举行。该赛季共有34支葡萄牙足球联赛前两级球队参赛，其中葡超18队、葡甲16队。

en.t: BKFC Fight Night Jackson: Brito vs. Harris II
en.s: On January 29, 2022, BKFC Fight Night Jackson: Brito vs. Harris II took place at Jackson Convention Complex in Jackson, Mississippi, United States.

zh.t: BKFC杰克逊格斗之夜：布里托对哈里斯二番战
zh.s: 2022年1月29日，BKFC杰克逊格斗之夜在美国密西西比州杰克逊会议中心举行，主赛为布里托对哈里斯二番战。

en.s: The 2023 Lower Austrian state election was held on 29 January 2023 to elect the members of the Landtag of Lower Austria. The ruling conservative ÖVP lost almost 10 percentage points and received slightly less than 40% of the vote, making it its worst election result in Lower Austria's history.

zh.s: 下奥地利州于2023年1月29日举行州议会选举。执政的保守派奥地利人民党得票率下降近10个百分点，降至略低于40%，创下该党在下奥地利州的历史最差成绩。

en.s: The 2022 Saudi Super Cup Final (also known as The Berain Saudi Super Cup Final for sponsorship reasons) was the 9th edition of the Saudi Super Cup. This was the first edition of the Saudi Super Cup to feature four teams following its expansion in 2022. The final was played on 29 January 2023 at the King Fahd International Stadium, Riyadh, between Al-Ittihad and Al-Fayha.

zh.s: 2022年沙特超级杯决赛因赞助也称贝莱茵沙特超级杯决赛，是第九届沙特超级杯的决赛。赛事于2022年扩军后，本届首次由四支球队参赛。决赛于2023年1月29日在利雅得法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由吉达联合对阵费哈。

en.s: The 2023 Supercopa Uruguaya was the sixth edition of the Supercopa Uruguaya, Uruguay's football super cup. It was held on 29 January 2023 between the 2022 Primera División champions Nacional and the 2022 Torneo Intermedio runners-up Liverpool at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo. Liverpool were the winners, beating Nacional 1–0 to claim their second Supercopa Uruguaya title.

zh.s: 2023年乌拉圭超级杯是第六届乌拉圭超级杯，于2023年1月29日在蒙得维的亚世纪球场举行。参赛双方是2022年甲级联赛冠军民族队和2022年中间锦标赛亚军利物浦队。利物浦以1比0获胜，第二次夺得乌拉圭超级杯冠军。

en.s: On 29 January 2024, the Danish frigate Iver Huitfeldt left Korsør, Denmark, heading for the Mediterranean ahead of its deployment to protect shipping. Parliamentary approval for deployment to the operational area followed in February.

zh.t: 丹麦“伊弗·休特菲尔德”号从科瑟启航
zh.s: 2024年1月29日，丹麦护卫舰“伊弗·休特菲尔德”号从科瑟启航，驶向地中海，为护航部署作准备。议会于2月批准该舰前往行动区域。

en.s: On 29 January 2025, a Beechcraft 1900 operated by Eagle Air on behalf of Light Air Services crashed in Unity State, located in the Greater Upper Nile region of South Sudan. The aircraft was on a routine scheduled charter flight from GPOC Unity Airstrip to Juba International Airport when it crashed shortly after takeoff, killing 20 out of 21 on board.

zh.t: 2025年Light Air Services比奇1900型飞机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2025年1月29日，鹰航代Light Air Services运营的一架比奇1900型飞机，在南苏丹大上尼罗地区的团结州坠毁。飞机当时执行从GPOC团结机场飞往朱巴国际机场的例行定期包机航班，起飞后不久坠毁，机上21人中有20人遇难。

en.t: Airliner and Army helicopter collide over the Potomac River
en.s: On January 29, 2025, at 8:48 p.m. Eastern time, American Airlines flight 5342, operated by PSA Airlines, collided with a US Army Black Hawk helicopter over the Potomac River near Washington, D.C., United States. All 64 people on the airplane and three on the helicopter died.

zh.t: 客机与美军直升机在波托马克河上空相撞
zh.s: 2025年1月29日美国东部时间晚8时48分，PSA航空执飞的美国航空5342航班与一架美军“黑鹰”直升机在华盛顿附近的波托马克河上空相撞。客机上的64人和直升机上的3人全部遇难。
